title: Inverted condition
detail: The condition `if cls.name:` checks if `cls.name` is truthy, which may not be the intended logic. The same applies to line 185.

title: Default parameters set to None
detail: The default parameters `environ` and `scope` are set to `None`, which may lead to unexpected behavior if these parameters are expected to be provided.

title: Incorrect response unpacking
detail: The response is unpacked using `app_iter, status, headers = run_wsgi_app(self.application, request.environ, buffered=buffered)`, which assumes `run_wsgi_app` returns a tuple. However, `run_wsgi_app` now returns a `TestResponse` object, which may not be compatible with this unpacking.

title: Incorrect response wrapper
detail: The response is wrapped using `self.response_wrapper(app_iter, status, headers, request=request)`, which assumes `app_iter`, `status`, and `headers` are separate. However, `run_wsgi_app` now returns a `TestResponse` object, which may not be compatible with this wrapping.

title: Incorrect response creation
detail: The response is created using `Response(*run_wsgi_app(response, environ))`, which assumes `run_wsgi_app` returns a tuple. However, `run_wsgi_app` now returns a `TestResponse` object, which may not be compatible with this unpacking.

title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition `elif fp is not None:` will skip the `continue` statement if `fp` is not `None`, which is likely not the intended behavior. It should be `elif fp is None:` to skip the iteration when `fp` is `None`.

title: Wider exception handling
detail: Replacing PermissionError with OSError can mask other issues like FileNotFoundError or NotADirectoryError. The same applies to line 508.
